summary: Verified role-specific dashboards overhaul + regression of core flows for Agrocorp Lite. Backend /api/dashboard returns distinct role-specific payloads for all 4 roles (admin, accounts, post_sales, site_manager) with expected keys (sales_booked, procurement_approvals, recent_sales for admin; watchlist + procurement_awaiting_po + overdue amounts for accounts; my_sales_count/value + recent_sales for post_sales; inventory_count/low_stock/procurement_by_status/recent_procurement for site_manager). Frontend: each role logs in and sees a DIFFERENT, correctly-branded dashboard: Admin => Command Center (Total Sales Booked ₹65.78L, Payments Pending, Procurement Queue KPIs + secondary counters + Procurement Needs Action + Recent Sales tables); Accounts => The Ledger (Pending ₹40.17L, Overdue ₹19.62L, Received ₹18.61L + Payment Watchlist + Approved-Awaiting-PO panel); Post-Sales => Post-Sales Desk (Plots Available 253, Sold 3, Value Booked + Recent Sales + Your Contribution card + 'Mark a plot sold' button); Site Manager => Tactical Operations (Material Items / Low Stock / Open Requests / Approved KPIs + Low Stock + My Procurement Requests). data-testid='dashboard-page' present in all 4. Sidebar nav is role-filtered correctly (admin sees 7, accounts sees Dashboard/Sales/Procurement, post_sales sees Dashboard/Units/Sales, site_manager sees Dashboard/Inventory/Procurement). User menu + logout works. Regression flows all pass: (a) Post-Sales sold plot #100 in Vacation Village (buyer TEST_Buyer_Regr2, price 10L, booking 2L, schedule 8L) => 200, toast 'Sale recorded — accounts & admin notified', sold count 3->4; (b) Accounts marked a pending payment received via mark-{id}/mark-status/mark-submit; (c) Site Manager added inventory 'TEST_Cement_Regr' and raised procurement 'TEST_Regr Request'; (d) Admin reviewed & approved that procurement request => Approved toast + Record PO CTA. Notification bell opens without error. No console errors or pageerrors detected across all flows.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is now ~992 lines; consider splitting into routers/ (auth, projects, users, units, sales, payments, procurement, inventory, dashboard, notifications) — exceeds 700-line guideline.
Dashboard endpoint duplicates aggregation logic across 4 role branches; extract common projections into helper builders to keep DRY.
Login.jsx still calls navigate('/dashboard') during render when already logged in (flagged in iteration_1); low priority but produces React warning.
